<thought>The mass spectrum shows a dominant [M+H]+ peak at m/z 180.042, indicating a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈179.035 Da. The isotopic pattern (+1 peak ~10 % intensity) suggests about 9 carbons. Solving for a formula with 9 carbons that matches the mass gives C₉H₇O₄ (exact mass 179.0344 Da), which fits the observed mass within experimental error.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H7O4</final_answer>
